original_bug_description: Heap use-after-free in Zend/zend_generators.c: zend_generator_search_multi_children_node (reachable via zend_generator_add_child and zend_generator_yield_from) reads memory from a freed generator-related structure during "yield from" operations. This can cause crashes or other undefined behavior and may enable memory-corruption-based exploits when fed crafted generator state.

Heap use-after-free in Zend/zend_generators.c: zend_generator_search_multi_children_node (reachable via zend_generator_add_child and zend_generator_yield_from) reads memory from a freed generator-related structure during "yield from" operations. This can cause crashes or other undefined behavior and may enable memory-corruption-based exploits when fed crafted generator state.
